description: Sthanakavasi teacher source inventory v2. Combines Task 25 JainQQ discoveries with Task 26 Jainebooks discoveries.

teachers.name: Namramuni Maharaj
teachers.evidence_of_sthanakvasi: Jainebooks author page identifies him as Sthanakvasi Muni. Look-N-Learn series is educational practice material.
teachers.training_suitability: HIGH — confirmed Sthanakvasi Muni with practice guides

teachers.name: Amarmuni
teachers.evidence_of_sthanakvasi: Commentator on JainQQ Sthanakvasi Agam editions (Avashyak, Sthanang, Nishith)
teachers.training_suitability: HIGHEST — complete Avashyak commentary covering all 6 practices

teachers.name: Acharya Ghanshilalji Maharaj
teachers.evidence_of_sthanakvasi: Priydarshini commentary on Uttaradhyayana, Sthanakvasi edition

teachers.name: Muni Kanhaiyalalji Maharaj
teachers.evidence_of_sthanakvasi: Sanskrit/Prakrit commentary on Kalpa Sutra, Sthanakvasi edition

teachers.name: Sagarmal Jain
teachers.evidence_of_sthanakvasi: Author of 'Sthanakvasi Jain Parampara ka Itihas' — the tradition's own history

teachers.name: Pravin Rishi Upadhyay
teachers.evidence_of_sthanakvasi: Listed in Jain eLibrary master list as Sthanakvasi author

teachers.name: Acharya Anand Rishi
teachers.evidence_of_sthanakvasi: Sthanakvasi Acharya, guru was Ratna Rishiji
teachers.training_suitability: UNKNOWN — no digital texts located on JainQQ or Jainebooks

teachers.name: Kanji Swami
teachers.evidence_of_sthanakvasi: Born to Sthanakvasi family, became Sthanakvasi monastic 1913 under Hirachanda. Later influenced by Digambara Kundakunda.
teachers.training_suitability: COMPLEX — originally Sthanakvasi but later work is Digambara-influenced. Use early Sthanakvasi material only.

teachers.name: Kalyanvijayji
teachers.evidence_of_sthanakvasi: Gani (monk) in Sthanakvasi tradition. Author of Launkagacchha aur Sthanakvasi.
